name: contract_m2m3_tables
description: The M2/M3 contract (docs/design/contract-m2m3.md) holds: the id lists start with the ids it fixed and a mode's and a Builder's index is its id on the wire; the Lamplighter's and the Lookout's BUILDERS entries have exactly the fixed fields, their kits and branches agree with TOWERS, their covers and patches name checks, their accents stay unsaturated; every tower form, check, role, Builder and perk has its display entry and icon path in Game, and a path whose art is not painted yet loads as the placeholder without an error; the rules hash leaves names out and keeps every BUILDERS field the simulation reads, through any SimContent helper it calls (the caretaker's forks follow covers); the coverage helpers and the new event and effect numbers are the contract's.

steps.msg: the tables keep the M2/M3 contract

steps.assert: sim_reads.has('covers') and sim_reads.has('towers') and sim_reads.has('perk') and sim_reads.has('plan')
steps.msg: the simulation's reads of BUILDERS are all seen
